purpose: Player-confirmed public company profile enrichment for game scenarios
rules: No lookup occurs without player opt-in.
GLEIF queries pass through a same-origin proxy, are not persisted by the game, and cannot target arbitrary upstream hosts.
The player must confirm the matched entity.
Public facts, game inference and player input must remain distinguishable.
Missing public data must not be treated as evidence that a fact is false.
Company profile data must not be used as a legal conclusion or allegation.

activeSources.name: Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation LEI Data API
